name: Open Source Security Foundation (OpenSSF)
description: Operates under the Linux Foundation to secure open source software through projects like SLSA, Sigstore, and GUAC. All projects undergo community review through working groups.

peerReview.processDescription: SLSA: Peer-reviewed framework for supply chain integrity. Sigstore: Standard for signing/verifying software releases. GUAC: Directed insights into software supply chain security. All projects undergo community review through working groups and technical advisory council.

attribution.attributionNotes: OpenSSF projects like SLSA and Sigstore are becoming industry standards. OpenSSF Ambassador status awarded to community leaders.

povsAlignment.description: Code repository contribution through open source security projects and working groups.
